title: Beach photo of a suited being in Baja California
summary: Ammar Kandil tells of Beach photo of a suited being in Baja California, about recent at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Ammar Kandil, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story from a friend of a friend: his best friend's sister's best friend. He says she was in Baja California, Mexico, taking photos on the beach at sunset, and one of the pictures showed a being in some kind of suit. If true, it would be a chance photo of a non-human visitor.
